import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})

CLS_COLOR = '#0072B2'
CWM_COLOR = '#E69F00'

# Data
groups = ['4B (5 seeds)', '8B (3 seeds)']
cls_means = [88.43, 89.40]
cls_stds = [0.78, 1.09]
cwm_means = [87.19, 86.96]
cwm_stds = [0.36, 0.72]
gaps = [1.24, 2.43]

x = np.arange(len(groups))
bar_width = 0.30

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4.5))

bars_cls = ax.bar(x - bar_width/2, cls_means, bar_width, yerr=cls_stds,
                  color=CLS_COLOR, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5,
                  capsize=4, error_kw={'linewidth': 1.5, 'color': 'black', 'capthick': 1.5},
                  label='CLS', zorder=3)

bars_cwm = ax.bar(x + bar_width/2, cwm_means, bar_width, yerr=cwm_stds,
                  color=CWM_COLOR, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5,
                  capsize=4, error_kw={'linewidth': 1.5, 'color': 'black', 'capthick': 1.5},
                  label='CWM', zorder=3)

# Gap annotations with brackets
for i, (cm, wm, cs, ws, gap) in enumerate(zip(cls_means, cwm_means, cls_stds, cwm_stds, gaps)):
    top_cls = cm + cs + 0.15
    top_cwm = wm + ws + 0.15
    bracket_y = max(top_cls, top_cwm) + 0.3

    left_x = x[i] - bar_width/2
    right_x = x[i] + bar_width/2

    # Bracket: vertical ticks + horizontal bar
    tick_h = 0.15
    ax.plot([left_x, left_x], [bracket_y, bracket_y + tick_h], color='#333333', linewidth=1.2, zorder=4)
    ax.plot([right_x, right_x], [bracket_y, bracket_y + tick_h], color='#333333', linewidth=1.2, zorder=4)
    ax.plot([left_x, right_x], [bracket_y + tick_h, bracket_y + tick_h], color='#333333', linewidth=1.2, zorder=4)

    ax.text((left_x + right_x) / 2, bracket_y + tick_h + 0.2,
            f'Δ = {gap:.2f}pp', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', color='#333333')

# "Gap widens" arrow between the two gap annotations
arrow_y = max(cls_means[0] + cls_stds[0], cwm_means[0] + cwm_stds[0]) + 0.3 + 0.15 + 0.2 + 0.55
ax.annotate('', xy=(x[1], arrow_y + 0.35), xytext=(x[0], arrow_y + 0.35),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#999999', linewidth=1.3, linestyle='--'))
ax.text((x[0] + x[1]) / 2, arrow_y + 0.55, 'gap widens', ha='center', va='bottom',
        fontsize=9, fontstyle='italic', color='#777777')

ax.set_ylabel('Accuracy (%)')
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(groups)
ax.set_ylim(84, 92.5)
ax.yaxis.set_major_locator(plt.MultipleLocator(1))
ax.yaxis.set_minor_locator(plt.MultipleLocator(0.5))
ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linewidth=0.5, zorder=0)

# Zero-shot reference note
ax.text(0.02, 0.02, 'Zero-shot refs: 8B = 64.4%, 32B NF4 = 71.7% (off-scale)',
        transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=8.5, color='#888888', va='bottom')

ax.legend(loc='upper left', frameon=True, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#cccccc')

out_dir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_16/projects/exec-sim-repair-verifier/artifacts/figures/paper'
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig2_scaling_gap.pdf')
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig2_scaling_gap.png', dpi=300)
plt.close()
print('Done.')
